title: Biden administration reportedly authorises Ukraine to use US long-range missiles inside Russia
body:
On 17 November 2024 Euromaidan Press, citing reports from The New York Times and Reuters, said that the Biden administration had authorised Ukraine to use US-supplied weapons for strikes deep inside Russian territory. The weapons likely involved were Army Tactical Missile Systems, known as ATACMS, which have a range of about 190 miles. The Times reported that Ukraine would first target Russian and North Korean troops in Kursk Oblast and that the president could later approve other targets.

The report linked the decision to the deployment of North Korean forces, estimated at over 10,000 troops, and to concern about an expected Russian assault on Ukrainian positions in Kursk, reportedly involving about 50,000 soldiers. Ukraine had asked for the restrictions to be lifted for months, including by presenting a list of high-value Russian targets in Washington in August. The decision came before Donald Trump's inauguration. The White House declined to comment.

Western countries had previously restricted long-range strikes into Russia largely out of fear of nuclear escalation. The report said the change divided Biden's advisers, and that a US intelligence assessment warned of stepped-up arson and sabotage in Europe in response. Ukraine had already used ATACMS within its own territory for more than a year.
